note: 100-point Facebook Page (or professional-mode profile) rubric. Points are judgement calls weighted by how much each part decides whether a stranger trusts, follows or messages you. Edit the weights to match your goals.

parts.name: Page name
parts.check: The name people would search. Brand plus what you do or where, if the brand alone says nothing. No keyword stuffing, no emoji, under 75 characters.
parts.fail: 'Best Cheap Cakes Kathmandu Online Delivery 24/7' or an internal nickname nobody searches.

parts.name: Username / vanity URL
parts.check: Set, short, matches the name and other platforms.
parts.fail: facebook.com/profile.php?id=1000... or a different handle from Instagram.

parts.name: Profile picture
parts.check: Readable at 40px: a face for a personal brand, a simple logo mark for a business. Not cropped by the circle.
parts.fail: A full wordmark that becomes unreadable, or a photo where the face is tiny.

parts.name: Cover photo or video
parts.check: Says what you do and for whom in one glance, and works on mobile (the edges get cropped). Ideally shows the outcome or the product.
parts.fail: A generic stock image, or text that sits where mobile crops it.

parts.name: Intro / bio (101 chars)
parts.check: Who it's for, what they get, and a reason to believe, in plain words. Reads as a promise, not a welcome.
parts.fail: 'Welcome to our official page!' or a list of services with no audience.

parts.name: About / description (155-255 chars)
parts.check: The words people search for, in sentences: what, where, for whom. This text shows in search results under the name.
parts.fail: Empty, or a copy of the intro, or a mission statement with no nouns.

parts.name: Linked accounts & website
parts.check: Website, WhatsApp and Instagram connected and working. Links go somewhere that matches the Page.
parts.fail: A dead website, or an Instagram that has nothing to do with the Page.

parts.name: Category
parts.check: The most specific category that fits, so Facebook search and recommendations understand you.
parts.fail: 'Company' or 'Personal blog' when a specific one exists.

parts.name: Contact & location
parts.check: Phone or WhatsApp, email, address or service area, hours, all current. Local businesses: map pin set.
parts.fail: Old phone number, missing hours, or no city at all.

parts.name: Action button
parts.check: One button matched to the one thing you want: Send message, Book now, Call, WhatsApp, Shop.
parts.fail: 'Learn more' to a homepage, or no button.

parts.name: Featured / pinned post
parts.check: A pinned post that does the job of an intro: what you do, proof, how to start. Updated in the last 90 days.
parts.fail: Nothing pinned, or a pinned 2022 promotion.

parts.name: Recent activity
parts.check: Posted in the last 7 days, mostly original content, a mix that includes Reels. Nothing that looks reposted from other Pages.
parts.fail: Last post six weeks ago, or a feed of shared memes from other Pages.

parts.name: Message responsiveness
parts.check: Replies to messages within hours. Instant reply or FAQ set so first-time messages get an answer.
parts.fail: Unanswered messages in the inbox; 'typically replies within a week'.

parts.name: Reviews / recommendations & proof
parts.check: Recommendations turned on (if a business) with recent real ones, and replies to them. Proof posts in the feed.
parts.fail: Recommendations off, or bad reviews left unanswered.

bands.label: STRONG
bands.say: Fix the small stuff and spend your time on content.

bands.label: OK
bands.say: Two or three fixes will change how strangers read this Page.

bands.label: WEAK
bands.say: Fix the Page before you post more. Traffic you send here is leaking.
